name: Speridlabs
description: 开发空间基础模型Mundus,为机器人、游戏和特效提供可查询、可修改的3D空间建模能力,保持几何形状在部分修改时的持久性
description_en: Develops spatial foundational models, specifically Mundus, for robotics, gaming, and special effects with queryable and modifiable 3D geometry that remains persistent when parts are changed
why_matters: 与Runway、Odyssey等竞争对手相比,Speridlabs的Mundus模型解决了现有世界模型无法查询或修改的关键限制,被称为'3D版Midjourney',在3D空间建模领域提供了可编辑性的技术突破
why_matters_en: Unlike competitors like Runway, Odyssey, and Google's Genie that cannot be queried or modified, Speridlabs' Mundus model addresses this critical limitation by keeping geometry persistent during modifications, earning it the label of '3D Midjourney'
latest_news: 入选PearX加速器2026年10月批次,在Demo Day上引起风投关注
latest_news_en: Selected for PearX accelerator October 2026 batch, generated buzz among VCs at demo day
source_title: 5 startups that caught VCs’ attention at the latest PearX demo day

evidence.quote: it argues that its more established competitors, including Runway, Odyssey, and Google's Genie, cannot be queried or modified. To solve this, Speridlabs built Mundus, which it calls a 3D Midjourney because it keeps its geometry persistent when a part is changed.

TechCrunch attended Pear's latest demo day, which took place in San Francisco last week, and then stuck around to ask some of the VCs about which companies stood out to them out of the 16 startups in the batch.

name: Datum
description: 工业设计AI工程师,索引公司的3D设计库,使用专有的几何指纹技术根据形状识别零部件,帮助工程师查找和使用以前构建的设计,简化物理产品开发
description_en: AI engineer for industrial design that indexes a company's library of 3D designs and uses proprietary Geometric Fingerprint technology to identify parts based on their shape, helping engineers find and reuse previous designs to expedite physical product development
why_matters: 使用专有的几何指纹技术解决了工程师在大规模物理设计市场中查找和重用现有零部件的难题,通过自动化工程流程加速产品开发
why_matters_en: Uses proprietary Geometric Fingerprint technology to solve the challenge of finding and reusing existing parts in a massive physical design market, automating engineering workflows to streamline product development
